observations: Two photos show a stack of paperback books lying on their spines, viewed from different angles.

Spines read: Essential Civic Education, Essential Commerce, Essential Agric. Science (x3), Essential Biology (x3), Essential Financial Accounting (x2), Essential Christian Religious Studies, Essential Physics (x2), Essential Economics — all 'For Senior Secondary Schools'.
Author names are printed on several spines (e.g., O.A. Iwena, M.C. Michael, R.A. Ibrahim & R.A. Kazeem, O.E. Farinde et al.).
No front or back covers, no interior pages, no publisher logo, and no edition/year are visible in either photo.
A faint watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI' appears across photo 1, indicating the image is a reused listing photo.

identity.kind: bundle of senior secondary school textbooks ('Essential' series, multiple subjects)

claims.claim: Essential textbooks are available for international parents who want the best from their...
claims.evidence: No photo shows condition, completeness, or any basis for a quality/suitability claim; text is marketing language only.

risks.risk: Condition of pages (writing, torn/missing pages, water damage, mold) cannot be assessed from spine-only shots.
risks.proof: Photo of open front cover and a few interior pages per title, or a short video flipping through each book.

risks.risk: Exact count and completeness of the set (titles, number of copies per subject) is unclear from a stacked spine view.
risks.proof: A flat-laid photo or itemized list showing each title and copy count clearly.

risks.risk: Edition/curriculum year may be outdated relative to current Nigerian senior secondary syllabus.
risks.proof: Photo of the title/copyright page showing publisher and year for each book.

risks.risk: Image reuse watermark ('POSTED ON JIJI') suggests the photo may be from a different, older listing, not necessarily the actual stock on hand.
risks.proof: A fresh, timestamped photo of the same books (e.g., with today's date or a handwritten note visible).
risks.if_unproven: priced as unverified stock, same as worst-case condition

proof_requests: Front cover and interior page photos for each distinct title.
A single flat-lay photo showing all books with spines and covers visible, to confirm count.
Close-up of title/copyright page for edition and year.
A fresh photo with a handwritten date or seller's name to confirm current possession.
response.reason: The books are clearly identifiable by type (senior secondary school textbooks) and titles are legible, but condition, completeness, and edition remain unproven, so the bundle is priced at worst-case (heavily used, unverified completeness) until further photos are supplied.
